title: 第0013章 危机周通的谋划第0014章 炼气三层被人跟踪
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
周通眼睛一眯，还是不确定：“你是一年前那个炼气一层杂役弟子，在我这里接了任务？”
陆青禾点头回答：“是的，一年前师兄给机会，让我获得如此福运，在这里师弟多谢师兄。”
他这话倒是多了几分真诚，要不是周通，他也不会发现黑土空间的妙用，让实力突飞猛进。
周通奇怪的问道：“你是如何种植出来千斤灵米的？”
陆青禾不明白周通的意思，挠挠头回答：“就是按照师兄给的玉简，每天浇水，防止虫害。”
陆青禾简单的将灵米的浇灌和管理讲了一遍，让人看不出任何的异常之处。
“我就是这样种植的，全部灵米我都带来了，师兄明鉴，我一粒灵米都不敢贪墨，全部上交宗门。”
这也是他为什么多出五斤的原因，让人挑不出毛病。
周通不相信陆青禾的话，他眼神灼灼的看着陆青禾：“就这样简单？”
陆青禾回答：“就是这样的，难道师兄认为有什么问题吗？”
周通面露思索，难道是自己之前的判断错了，那灵田根本没有被破坏，还能够继续种植灵米。
还是眼前的小子有什么奇特之处，这怪不得他会这样想，陆青禾虽然没有表现出灵力。
可是身上的气息绝对不是炼气一层的气息，而是炼气二层，一年时间进阶一层，这对一个五灵根的杂役来说是完全不可能的事情。
不管是什么情况，周通都打算等事情处理好之后去探查一番。
周通不动声色的说道：“没有，这是100功德点，只不过今年没有灵石奖励了。”
这点陆青禾已经预料到了，刚才那些交接的弟子也是只获得功德点，灵石都被告知没有。
大家都虽然怀疑这是周通中饱私囊，但是也不敢质问，周通外门弟子，炼气六层的实力不是他们可以得罪的。
再加上掌管事务殿，后面的任务也要靠着周通，得罪周通被打击报复绝对没有好果子吃。
陆青禾面色如常，现在他也不敢得罪周通，但是这笔账他记下了。

他相信靠着黑土空间，他的修炼速度以后要比周通这样的外门弟子快，到时候实力足够，找机会将这些连本带利的找回来。
陆青禾接回令牌，拱拱手：“多谢师兄。”
陆青禾转身离开了事务殿，他并没有选择回杂役院，他担心等会周通会找上门来。
他一刻不停歇，来到太玄宗一个偏僻的角落找了一个不起眼的荒山躲了进去。
陆青禾挖了一个小型的洞府，算是临时住，布置好之后，陆青禾将洞府给掩藏了起来。
看着自己的杰作，陆青禾有些惋惜：“要是能够获得一个阵法就完美了。”
修仙四大艺，丹，器，阵，符。
阵法是其中一个比较厉害的技能。
有阵法可以遮掩天地气机，有阵地能够防御敌人的攻击，也有杀伐阵法能够镇杀强敌，还有困阵，迷阵，聚灵阵各种能力各异的阵法。
就像太玄宗也是被一座巨大的阵法覆盖，才让外面看起来只是一座荒山一样。
但是阵法造价昂贵，哪怕是一个低等级的阵法，也需要过百的灵石。
“接下来努力突破炼气三层，至于杂役任务，等段时间再考虑。”

Zhou Tong narrowed his eyes, still unsure: "Are you the handyman disciple at the first level of Qi Refining who took over the task from me a year ago?"
Lu Qinghe nodded and replied: "Yes, senior brother gave me the opportunity a year ago and allowed me to get such a good fortune. Thank you very much, senior brother."
His words were a little more sincere. If it weren't for Zhou Tong, he wouldn't have discovered the magical effect of the black earth space, which made his strength increase by leaps and bounds.
Zhou Tong asked strangely: "How did you grow a thousand catties of spiritual rice?"
Lu Qinghe didn't understand what Zhou Tong meant, scratched his head and replied: "Just follow the jade slips given by senior brother and water them every day to prevent insect damage."
Lu Qinghe briefly explained the watering and management of spiritual rice, so that no one could see anything unusual.
"That's how I planted it. I brought all the spiritual rice. Senior brother Mingjian, I don't dare to be greedy for a single grain of spiritual rice. I handed it all over to the sect."
This is also the reason why he has five extra pounds, which makes it difficult for people to find fault.
Zhou Tong didn't believe Lu Qinghe's words. He looked at Lu Qinghe with burning eyes: "Is it that simple?"
Lu Qinghe replied: "That's it. Does senior brother think there is any problem?"
Zhou Tong looked thoughtful and wondered whether his previous judgment was wrong. The spiritual field was not destroyed at all and he could continue to plant spiritual rice.
There was something strange about the boy in front of him. No wonder he thought so. Although Lu Qinghe didn't show any spiritual power.
But the aura on his body is definitely not the aura of the first level of Qi Refining, but the second level of Qi Refining. It takes one year to advance to the first level. This is completely impossible for a handyman with five spiritual roots.
No matter what the situation was, Zhou Tong planned to investigate after the matter was settled.
Zhou Tong said calmly: "No, this is 100 merit points, but there is no spirit stone reward this year."
Lu Qinghe had already expected this. The disciples who handed over just now only received merit points and were told that they had no spiritual stones.
Although everyone suspected that Zhou Tong was lining his own pockets, they did not dare to question Zhou Tong's outer disciples. Their strength at the sixth level of Qi Refining was not something they could offend.
In addition, he is in charge of the affairs palace, and he will also rely on Zhou Tong for subsequent tasks. Offending Zhou Tong and being retaliated will definitely not bring good results.
Lu Qinghe's expression remained as usual. He didn't dare to offend Zhou Tong now, but he remembered the account.
He believes that relying on the black earth space, his cultivation speed will be faster than that of outer disciples like Zhou Tong in the future. When the time comes, he will be strong enough to find an opportunity to get these things back with profit.
Lu Qinghe took the token back and held it in his hand: "Thank you, senior brother."
Lu Qinghe turned and left the affairs hall. He did not choose to go back to the miscellaneous service hall. He was worried that Zhou Tong would come to his door later.
Without stopping for a moment, he came to a remote corner of Taixuanzong and found an inconspicuous barren mountain to hide in.
Lu Qinghe dug a small cave as a temporary residence. After setting it up, Lu Qinghe hid the cave.
Looking at his masterpiece, Lu Qinghe felt a little regretful: "It would be perfect if I could get a formation."
The four major arts of cultivating immortals are elixirs, weapons, formations, and talismans.
Formation is one of the more powerful skills.
There are formations that can conceal the energy of heaven and earth, there are formations that can defend against enemy attacks, there are also killing formations that can suppress powerful enemies, and there are also formations with trapping formations, confusion formations, and spirit-gathering formations with different abilities.
Just like Taixuanzong was covered by a huge formation, making the outside look like just a barren mountain.
However, formations are expensive to build. Even a low-level formation requires over a hundred spirit stones.
"Next, we will work hard to break through the third level of Qi Refining. As for the chore tasks, we will consider them after a while."
